mapper.update: UPDATE USER_ADDRESS SET DEFAULT_YN = 'N' WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND DEFAULT_YN = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO USER_ADDRESS ( ADDRESS_ALIAS, ZIPCODE, ADDRESS, DETAILED_ADDRESS, DEFAULT_YN, USER_ID ) VALUES ( #{addressAlias}, #{zipCode}, #{address}, #{detailedAddress}, #{defaultYn}, #{userId} )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM USER_ADDRESS WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY CASE WHEN DEFAULT_YN = 'Y' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, ADDRESS_ID DESC
